description.value: Hjorth Road Outdoor Pool is a seasonal municipal outdoor swimming pool operated by the City of Surrey, offering public swims and swimming lessons. It sits in a residential neighbourhood and could serve as a refreshing stop for touring cyclists passing through Surrey during summer months.
